queue.brief: #147 measured the allotments as monoculture BY CONSTRUCTION — species per plot 1.000 over 69,008 sown samples — and wrote the invariant into `plotCrop()` along with the successor read for the day it stops holding. #152 then built the hand that could stop it, but `plotAct()`'s sow rung still fills bare cells with `plotCrop()` itself, so the plot stays one crop (the comment at ~line 3996 says exactly that). One predicate, one definition: every downstream reader of plotCrop must be walked, not assumed.
